relations: If shell, wax pool, and wick remain fixed, the flame can elongate upward while its base stays anchored.
As the flame stretches taller, its body narrows and the tip rises toward the top of the frame.
Small flickers modulate flame width and outline, while warm glow on melted wax remains roughly constant.
Shell rim, wax pool, and wick keep fixed screen positions during the flame's upward development.
caption: The video captures a single lit candle seated in a shallow, scallop-shell-like holder, its wick rising from a pool of melted wax that glows warmly against an otherwise pure black background. The shell rim, the wax pool, and the wick keep fixed screen positions across the sequence. The flame itself is the only luminous element and the focus of the visible change. In the early frames it stands as a short, broad teardrop whose yellow-orange cap sits well below the upper edge of the frame. As the clip proceeds, the flame stretches upward and narrows, its body thinning into a tall, slender spike whose tip climbs toward the top of the image. The pointed apex deepens into a thinner reddish-orange thread while small frame-to-frame flickers modulate its width and outline. The overall trend is one of upward elongation rather than collapse, and the warm glow cast on the wax stays roughly constant as the segment runs.
